name: Carrias (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of red, yellow and green in the proportions 3:4:3, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Carrias (a tower on red and a sheep on green).
history: The arms and the flag were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 161 of 21 August 2002 and inaugurated on 10 March 2003 at a ceremony attended by many residents and provincial authorities; the flag is square, of three horizontal stripes of red, yellow and green, the central one 4/10 and the others 3/10 of the height, with the municipal arms at its heart.
